name: Cone Beam Forward Projection with Trilinear Interpolation
definition: Computes the projection of a 3D volume onto a 2D detector array for cone beam geometry. It uses trilinear interpolation to sample the volume along rays defined by source and detector positions.
summary: Cone Beam Forward Projection with Trilinear Interpolation computes line integrals along rays to simulate projection data, distinguished by its explicit handling of 3D-to-2D perspective geometry using trilinear interpolation.
